Ada (Growth): Quick sync: finalizing a 25m mini-webinar 'Launchpad: Production Plays' — 3 plays + micro-demo. Need final run-of-show, CTAs, and rehearsal time today.

Noah (Producer): Proposed format: host intro, two 6-min plays, one 6-min customer vignette, 4-min demo, 3-min CTA. Greenroom 30m prior.

Maria (Content): Draft plays: 1) batching patterns (cost), 2) private deploy checklist (compliance), 3) graceful fallbacks (reliability). Will push 2-line speaker briefs.

Sam (Eng): I'll prep a recorded fallback demo and a short live query as backup. Demo infra checklist: model primary `redwood/opt-2026`, fallback `redwood/opt-4bit`. Test run 9:15 PT day-of.

Priya (CMO): CTA hierarchy: primary - Request Dedicated Eval; secondary - free bench run (credits). Amplify with partner co-post.

Ada (Growth): Lead routing: high intent -> HubSpot tag `dedicated-trial`; low intent -> product nurture. Noah, add hidden form fields for mapping.

Noah (Producer): Done. I set utm_campaign=launchpad_q2. Run-of-show draft posted to Drive.

rehearsals-bot: Rehearsal reserved 2026-04-02 09:00 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood/rehearsal-1798889999

Maria (Content): Social copy + two subject lines uploaded. Also five eval prompts for post-demo quality checks in the drive.

Ada (Growth): Assignments: Maria - landing & email by EOD; Sam - demo assets by EOD; Noah - form + greenroom invites; Priya - partner push. React :thumbsup: when complete.

Sam (Eng): :thumbsup: demo assets uploaded.

Noah (Producer): :thumbsup: invites sent.

Maria (Content): :thumbsup: drafts done.

Ada (Growth): Locked. We'll monitor signups and escalate to SDRs if >50 in 24h. Thanks team.
